contacts.name: Alex Example
contacts.overrideBody: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw you're bringing your evening of new songs to The Example Room on August 3. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage, which suits a room that size. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one-hour minimum, with the gallery delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com/performing-arts.

draft.subject: Photographing Alex Example's new songs at The Example Room.
draft.body: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw Alex Example is bringing an evening of new songs to The Example Room on August 3. My work includes Carnegie Hall, where I have shot for nearly ten years, and it suits a room that size: unobtrusive, no flash, documentary. You can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. I would be glad to talk about your photography plans for the night. I look forward to hearing from you.
